source_refs.excerpt: Northbridge Field Services Ltd was founded in 2012. The UK business provides equipment maintenance and technical field support to industrial and logistics customers. Its headquarters are in Birmingham. The transaction perimeter is the entire standalone UK company.

The business supplies scheduled maintenance under annual service contracts, reactive repairs and installation projects. Contracts generally run for one to three years and renew by agreement. Scheduled maintenance provides the contracted revenue stream. No assumption should be made that renewals are automatic. Customers include logistics operators, manufacturers and facilities managers.

At 31 December 2025, Northbridge has 120 employees including 85 field engineers. It operates hubs in Birmingham, Manchester and Bristol. Maya Reed is founder and CEO, Daniel Cole is CFO and Aisha Patel is COO. These names and all company details are fictitious. The founder continues to lead major customer relationships.

Management plans to add 20 net field engineers by the end of FY2027, cross-sell scheduled maintenance to repair customers and expand service coverage from existing hubs. The plan assumes sufficient technician recruitment and contract renewals. No signed pipeline or customer-cohort evidence accompanies this briefing.
[00:28] CEO: Growth depends on technician recruitment, renewals and converting more repair customers to maintenance contracts. We plan 20 net new engineers by FY2027.
Management describes the UK equipment-maintenance market as fragmented. No independent market-size study, market-share estimate or competitor benchmarking has been provided.

facts.limitations: Fragmentation is a management assertion without independent support.
